import numpy as np

def softmax(x, axis=-1):
    x = x - x.max(axis=axis, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(x)
    return e / e.sum(axis=axis, keepdims=True)

def multi_head_attention(X, Wq, Wk, Wv, Wo, n_heads={{n_heads}}, d_model={{d_model}}):
    n, _ = X.shape
    d_k = d_model // n_heads
    Q = (X @ Wq).reshape(n, n_heads, d_k).transpose(1, 0, 2)
    K = (X @ Wk).reshape(n, n_heads, d_k).transpose(1, 0, 2)
    V = (X @ Wv).reshape(n, n_heads, d_k).transpose(1, 0, 2)
    scores = Q @ K.transpose(0, 2, 1) / np.sqrt(d_k)
    attn = softmax(scores, axis=-1)
    out = attn @ V
    out = out.transpose(1, 0, 2).reshape(n, d_model)
    return out @ Wo
